si_tags.full: More than %{count} tags make the row hard to read.
si_tags.how: How it looks in the title
si_tags.lead: Define your own tags. On the stream info page they can be ticked individually; the ticked ones appear in square brackets before the title.
si_tags.name: Stream info – tags
si_tags.rule_brackets: Square brackets in a tag name are removed: the prefix in the title is itself a bracket and could not be read back unambiguously.
si_tags.rule_case: Reading back ignores upper and lower case: if the title says “[german]”, the “German” box is ticked.
si_tags.rule_foreign: Brackets that do not contain a known tag stay part of the title – “[Notice] rebuild” is left alone.
si_tags.rule_length: Longer than %{count} characters is truncated – whatever sits before the title takes space away from it.
si_tags.rule_order: The order here is the order in the title – the topmost tag comes first.
si_tags.saved: Tags saved. The running title is untouched – it only changes the next time you save on the stream info page.
